units.text: Provision of financial support to the election campaign of a candidate or electoral association or the activities of a referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants outside their electoral funds or referendum funds; or performance of work, provision of services or sale of goods by legal entities, their branches, representative offices or other subdivisions free of charge or at unjustifiably low (high) rates, where connected with the conduct of an election or referendum and aimed at achieving a particular result in an election, putting forward an initiative to hold a referendum or achieving a particular result in a referendum; or performance of paid work, sale of goods or provision of paid services aimed at achieving a particular result in an election, putting forward an initiative to hold a referendum or achieving a particular result in a referendum without the documented consent of the candidate or the candidate's authorised financial representative, or the authorised financial representative of the electoral association, referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants, and without payment from the relevant electoral fund or referendum fund; or making donations to an electoral fund or referendum fund through straw persons; or providing a candidate, referendum initiative group or another group of referendum participants, for the conduct of the relevant election campaign or referendum campaign, with material support aimed at achieving a particular result in the election or referendum without compensation from the relevant electoral fund or referendum fund, where these actions do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
